query: Who won Nobel Prize for relativity?
original_answer:
No one won a Nobel Prize specifically “for relativity.” 

Albert Einstein, who developed special and general relativity, received the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for his explanation of the photoelectric effect, not for relativity. Later Nobels recognized tests or consequences of general relativity (e.g., 1993 Hulse & Taylor for the binary pulsar, 2017 Weiss/Barish/Thorne for gravitational waves, 2020 Penrose/Genzel/Ghez for black holes).
last_corrected_answer: Albert Einstein did not receive a Nobel Prize for relativity; his 1921 award was for the photoelectric effect.
final_answer: Albert Einstein did not receive a Nobel Prize for relativity; his 1921 award was for the photoelectric effect.
